v0.title: Find your bearings{{nameSuffix}}.
v0.body: Take a moment to meet the course team and explore how this course works. A little orientation now can make the first learning steps feel more familiar.

v1.title: Welcome to {{courseTitle}}.
v1.body: You have a place to begin: get to know the people and ideas behind this course. Come back as the course opens to discover your next steps.

v2.title: A new beginning{{nameSuffix}}.
v2.body: Start with curiosity. The course introduction and teaching team can help you understand what you will explore and where to find support.

v0.title: Good to have you here{{nameSuffix}}.
v0.body: Explore the course approach, meet your teaching team, and choose one manageable first step. Understanding grows through trying things and asking questions.

v1.title: Your learning starts here.
v1.body: You do not need to understand everything at once. Get familiar with the course, then use the suggested next step to begin exploring.

v2.title: Welcome aboard{{nameSuffix}}.
v2.body: Make this course your own: look around, meet the people who can help, and try a first task. Each question is a useful starting point.

v0.title: One focused step{{nameSuffix}}.
v0.body: An upcoming deadline deserves your attention. Open the task, check what is still needed, and give yourself a clear, manageable next step.

v1.title: Bring your work together.
v1.body: Use the deadline shown below to plan your remaining work. Review the task requirements and make sure your submission reflects what you have learned.

v2.title: Keep the next step small.
v2.body: When a deadline is close, clarity helps. Look at the highlighted task and work through the most useful remaining step.

v0.title: Make room for your next idea.
v0.body: There is work with an approaching deadline. Starting with one small part can give you time to test your understanding and ask for help.

v1.title: A little planning goes a long way.
v1.body: Check the highlighted deadline and decide where to begin. Breaking a task into smaller steps can make progress easier to see.

v2.title: Build momentum{{nameSuffix}}.
v2.body: Open the suggested task and find a good starting point. An early attempt can reveal which ideas you want to revisit.

v0.title: Stay in the loop{{nameSuffix}}.
v0.body: Your course team has an announcement worth reading. Check it before planning your next learning step.

v1.title: A course update for you.
v1.body: Take a look at the highlighted announcement. Knowing what has changed can help you focus your effort.

v2.title: Pause for a useful update.
v2.body: The teaching team has shared something important. Read the announcement, then return to the task that moves your learning forward.

v0.title: Your question has a new response.
v0.body: Someone has replied to a question you asked. See what they shared and use the discussion to develop your understanding.

v1.title: Keep the conversation going.
v1.body: An unread reply is waiting in your course discussion. It may offer a useful explanation or a new angle on your question.

v2.title: A new perspective{{nameSuffix}}.
v2.body: Return to your question and read the latest reply. If something is still unclear, the discussion is a good place to follow up.

v0.title: Prepare with purpose{{nameSuffix}}.
v0.body: Your registered exam is approaching. Check its details and use your course work to identify the ideas you want to revisit.

v1.title: Connect what you have learned.
v1.body: Review the exam information, then practise explaining the key ideas in your own words. Questions you still have can guide your preparation.

v2.title: Take stock before the exam.
v2.body: Check the exam details and choose a topic to review. Working through a familiar example can help you find gaps and build confidence.

v0.title: Turn feedback into a next step.
v0.body: Feedback on your work is available. Look for one insight you can use in your next attempt or a future task.

v1.title: See your work from another angle.
v1.body: Take a look at the feedback on your submission. Comparing it with your approach can make the learning behind the task clearer.

v2.title: Something to build on{{nameSuffix}}.
v2.body: Your feedback is ready to explore. Notice what worked and choose a specific point you would like to understand better.

v0.title: Welcome back{{nameSuffix}}.
v0.body: Take a fresh look at the course. Start with the highlighted step and recent updates, then choose a pace that helps you reconnect.

v1.title: Pick up the thread.
v1.body: A small step is a good way back in. Review what is available and choose one thing you would like to understand or finish.

v2.title: Begin again from here.
v2.body: You can start with what is in front of you. Use the next step and course updates to decide where your attention will help most.

v0.title: Keep your ideas moving{{nameSuffix}}.
v0.body: There is a task you can continue. Revisit your approach, try the next small part, and use questions to guide your thinking.

v1.title: Build on your first attempt.
v1.body: Return to the suggested task and see what you can develop further. Progress often comes from testing one idea at a time.

v2.title: Stay curious.
v2.body: Continue with the task below. If you get stuck, describing the problem clearly can help you find a different approach or ask a useful question.

v0.title: A new idea to try{{nameSuffix}}.
v0.body: A new exercise is available. Read the task, connect it with the course material, and make a first attempt.

v1.title: Put your understanding to work.
v1.body: Explore the newly available exercise. A small experiment can show you which concepts are already clear and which deserve another look.

v2.title: Your next challenge is ready.
v2.body: Open the new task and look for a manageable starting point. You can refine your understanding as you work through it.

v0.title: A fresh perspective awaits.
v0.body: New course material is available. Explore it and look for a connection to something you have already tried.

v1.title: Make a new connection{{nameSuffix}}.
v1.body: Take a look at the latest lecture material. Noting one question or example can help you engage with its ideas.

v2.title: Explore the next part of the course.
v2.body: The course has new material to discover. Give yourself space to read, reflect, and connect it with your work.

v0.title: A useful answer to explore.
v0.body: The course FAQ has an update. It may clarify something you have been wondering about or help with your next task.

v1.title: Learn from shared questions.
v1.body: Take a look at the latest FAQ. Questions from the course can reveal useful details and different ways to think about the material.

v2.title: One more piece of clarity.
v2.body: A new FAQ is available. Check the explanation and see how it connects to what you are working on.

v0.title: Choose what to explore next{{nameSuffix}}.
v0.body: Take a moment to reflect on your learning. You can revisit an idea, explore available work, or use a conversation to deepen your understanding.

v1.title: Give your understanding room to grow.
v1.body: Use the course overview to choose a useful next step. Explaining a concept or revisiting an example can reveal a new connection.

v2.title: Keep the curiosity going.
v2.body: There is more than one way to learn. Review your work, follow up on a question, or explore the next available course resource.

v0.title: Carry your learning forward{{nameSuffix}}.
v0.body: The course has ended. Reflect on the work you submitted and the ideas you want to keep developing. Available material and feedback can support your review.

v1.title: Look back with curiosity.
v1.body: Review your course experience and notice what has changed in your thinking. Your submitted work is one part of that story; there may be ideas you want to revisit.

v2.title: A foundation for what comes next.
v2.body: The course period is over, and your learning can continue. Use the available resources to reflect on your progress and identify something you would like to practise further.
